source_note: Re0微积分2：自然底数e及其快速计算
english_source_note: Re0 Calculus 2: The Number e and Fast Computation
callout_id: Re0微积分2:自然底数e及其快速计算#1
statement_en:
a. Prove that the sequence $$S_N:=\sum_{n=0}^{N}\frac{1}{n!}$$ has a limit.
b. Assuming $S_N\to e$, prove that $$e=3-\sum_{n\geq 0}\frac{1}{(n+1)(n+2)(n+2)!}$$
c. Use the above to give a more efficient way to approximate the limit $e$ of $S_N$ (including error analysis).
key_techniques: convergence of series via partial sums
callout_body:
a. 证明序列$$S_N:=\sum_{n=0}^{N}\frac{1}{n!}$$存在极限。
b. 假设$S_N\to e$，那么证明$$e=3-\sum_{n\geq 0}\frac{1}{(n+1)(n+2)(n+2)!}$$
c. 由上面给出近似计算$S_N$的极限$e$的更高效的方式(误差分析)。
